pr_title: OpenXR: Add support for retrieving play area
pr_body:
This PR implements the `get_play_area` feature on `OpenXRInterface`. This allows the user to retrieve the are within which they can safely move before encountering the guardian boundary.

This re-introduces the `get_play_space` feature in Godot 3s OpenXR support.

Closes: #85049

issue_context.title: OpenXR missing Boundary/Guardian API
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.2.dev 80de898d721f952dac0b102d48bb73d6b02ee1e8

### System information

OpenXR

### Issue description

The Godot 3 OpenXR plugin supported obtaining boundary/guardian information in order to obtain play space logic. While we do have a function in the `XRInterface` in Godot 4 that is supposed to retrieve this information (`get_play_area`) it is not implemented on the Godot 4 `OpenXRInterface`.

This logic needs to be ported.

### Steps to reproduce

Call `get_play_area`, be amazed by it not returning data :P

### Minimal reproduction project

Any XR project.

review_comments: Should this be exposed to gdscript?
It is through the `XRInterface`, it's a virtual method
